title: GiftCompass Persona (Recipient Interest Profile)
description: Structured, evidence-based interest profile of the gift RECEIVER. Produced by the Persona Builder from consented signals (quiz answers, manual input, or a receiver-donated export). This is interpretation, kept separate from the raw signals it was built from, and separate from the Gift Context (relationship / occasion / budget) which belongs to the SENDER's request.

persona_id.description: Opaque id. Never an account handle, phone number or email.

expires_at.description: Retention limit. After this the persona is deleted (PDPL storage limitation).

consent.description: PDPL Article 11 record. A persona without consent_given = true MUST NOT be used.

granted_by.description: Signal-based personas require 'receiver'. A sender-quiz persona describes the receiver but is given by the sender, so it is limited to the 'quiz' / 'manual' sources.

receiver_reviewed.description: True once the receiver saw the Preview & Approve screen and confirmed the inferred interests.

raw_data_deleted.description: True once the uploaded export and raw items were deleted. Must be true before the persona is reused.

recipient_basics.description: Coarse, non-identifying context only. No name, no handle, no exact birth date.

life_stage.description: Optional and self-declared. Never inferred from social signals.

interests.description: Only positive interests. A negatively-sentimented topic goes to `dislikes`, never here.

key.description: Must exist in interest-taxonomy.json. Joins to Product.interest_keys.

weight.description: weight = raw / (raw + 2), raw = SUM over evidence of (signal_strength * recency_decay). Saturating, so one loud signal cannot reach 1.0.

strength.description: strong >= 0.66, medium 0.33-0.66, weak < 0.33. Presentation band for the weight.

sentiment.description: Negative sentiment disqualifies an interest (P2: 'I hate Twilight' mentions Twilight but is a NO).

giftability.description: How well this interest converts into a buyable gift. Defaults from the taxonomy, may be adjusted by the Persona Builder.

evidence.description: At least one piece of evidence per interest. No evidence, no interest - this is what makes the persona auditable and lets the receiver remove what does not represent them.

signal_type.description: Signal strength ladder (P2 / Task 2): posted 1.00 > reposted 0.90 > saved 0.80 > liked 0.60 > followed 0.55 > watched 0.30. quiz_answer 0.85, manual_caption 0.70.

excerpt.description: Short human-readable trace shown on the Preview & Approve screen, e.g. a hashtag or quiz option. Never the full post, never a message.

removed_by_receiver.description: Kept as a tombstone so the same interest is not re-inferred on the next build.

dislikes.description: Hard negatives. Used as an exclusion filter before ranking, never as a weak penalty.

aesthetics.description: From taxonomy style_tags, e.g. minimal, cozy, sporty.

already_owns.description: Excluded at filter time so we do not recommend a duplicate.

blocked_attributes.description: Fixed deny-list, written into every persona as a self-check. The Persona Builder must refuse to emit any field describing these, even when the signals would allow it (P3: a few likes can expose very sensitive traits).

completeness.description: How much of the profile is filled. Drives the 'we only have a little to go on' message instead of inventing interests.

is_fallback.description: True when built from sender quiz only, because the receiver did not participate.
